name: Grilled chicken rice bowl
instructions: 1. Season and grill chicken breast until golden. 2. Warm the rice. 3. Slice avocado and toss fresh greens. 4. Assemble into a wholesome bowl.

name: Spinach omelette
instructions: 1. Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper. 2. Sauté baby spinach until wilted. 3. Pour eggs over spinach and cook on low heat. 4. Fold with fresh herbs and feta.

name: Chicken & greens skillet
instructions: 1. Cut chicken breast into bite-sized strips. 2. Sauté garlic in olive oil. 3. Add chicken and sear until cooked through. 4. Toss with seasonal vegetables and simmer until crisp-tender.

name: Grilled Chicken Bowl
description: Tender seasoned grilled chicken breast served over quinoa, charred corn, sweet tomatoes, and sliced fresh avocado.
instructions: 1. Season chicken with salt, pepper, cumin, and lime juice. 2. Grill for 6-8 minutes per side until charred and cooked through. 3. Warm quinoa and corn. 4. Arrange in a bowl with tomatoes, avocado, and chopped cilantro.

name: Garlic Butter Pasta
description: Silky al dente spaghetti tossed in rich golden garlic butter, finished with cracked black pepper and freshly grated parmesan.
instructions: 1. Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente. 2. In a skillet, melt butter with olive oil over medium-low heat. 3. Sauté minced garlic until fragrant and golden. 4. Toss pasta into garlic butter with pasta water. 5. Top with parmesan and parsley.

name: Berry Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick blended acai and wild berries topped with fresh strawberries, blueberries, chia seeds, sliced bananas, and coconut flakes.
instructions: 1. Blend frozen berries, 1/2 banana, and almond milk on high until smooth and thick. 2. Pour into a chilled bowl. 3. Neatly arrange sliced strawberries, blueberries, chia seeds, and coconut flakes on top.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Bowl
description: Herb-roasted chicken served over Greek lemon quinoa with crisp cucumbers, kalamata olives, tangy feta cheese, and tzatziki.
instructions: 1. Marinate chicken with oregano, garlic, olive oil, and lemon. 2. Grill or bake at 200°C for 20 minutes. 3. Slice chicken. 4. Assemble bowl with cucumber, olives, tomatoes, and crumbled feta. 5. Dollop fresh tzatziki.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Crisp romaine lettuce hearts tossed in creamy Caesar dressing with grilled chicken strips, shaved parmesan, and sourdough croutons.
instructions: 1. Season and sear chicken breast. 2. Chop crisp romaine lettuce. 3. Toss greens with Caesar dressing. 4. Top with sliced chicken, shaved parmesan, croutons, and cracked pepper.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
description: Chilled fusilli pasta with flaked tuna, sweet corn, diced red onion, celery, and a light Greek yogurt lemon-dill dressing.
instructions: 1. Cook pasta al dente and rinse with cool water. 2. Drain and flake tuna. 3. Mix yogurt, lemon juice, salt, and dill. 4. Combine pasta, tuna, corn, red onion, and celery with dressing. Chill before serving.

name: Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy golden whole-wheat pancakes made with ripe mashed bananas, served with pure maple syrup and fresh banana coins.
instructions: 1. Mash bananas in a bowl. 2. Whisk in eggs and milk. 3. Fold in flour, baking powder, and cinnamon. 4. Cook ladlefuls on a lightly greased non-stick skillet for 2-3 min per side. 5. Serve warm with maple syrup.

name: Avocado Toast
description: Artisan toasted sourdough bread spread with creamy mashed avocado, everything bagel seasoning, chili flakes, and microgreens.
instructions: 1. Toast sourdough slices until crispy and golden. 2. Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper. 3. Spread generously on warm toast. 4. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil, sprinkle seasoning, and top with microgreens.

name: Baked Salmon with Vegetables
description: Oven-baked Atlantic salmon fillet seasoned with lemon herb butter, roasted alongside fresh tender asparagus spears.
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C. 2. Season salmon with lemon, garlic, salt, and pepper. 3. Toss asparagus in olive oil. 4. Bake on a lined sheet pan for 18-20 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
description: Succulent pan-seared chicken glazed in homemade savory-sweet teriyaki sauce over steamed jasmine rice with broccoli.
instructions: 1. Steam jasmine rice. 2. Sauté sliced chicken until browned. 3. Whisk soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger. 4. Simmer sauce until glaze forms over chicken. 5. Serve with steamed broccoli and sesame seeds.

name: Greek Yogurt Bowl
description: Creamy Greek yogurt layered with organic honey, crunchy almond granola, and fresh seasonal strawberries.
instructions: 1. Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl. 2. Top with crunchy granola. 3. Slice strawberries and arrange on top. 4. Drizzle pure honey.

name: Mixed Nuts & Cranberries
description: Nutrient-dense raw almonds, walnuts, pumpkin seeds, and dried cranberries for sustained daily energy.
instructions: 1. Combine measured almonds, walnuts, and pumpkin seeds. 2. Toss with dried cranberries and a pinch of fine sea salt. 3. Portion into snack bags.
